get.description: Returns one movie by UUID. This read is public; an unknown movie returns 404.

put.description: Replaces the movie's catalogue fields. A missing movie returns 404. Requires ADMIN.

delete.description: Hard-deletes a movie only when it has no showtimes. Requires ADMIN; an unknown movie returns 404 and dependent showtimes cause 409.

get.description: Returns one cinema by UUID. The read is public; an unknown cinema returns 404.

put.description: Replaces a cinema's name and address. The cinema must exist; a missing cinema returns 404. Requires ADMIN.

delete.description: Hard-deletes a cinema that has no auditoriums. An authenticated ADMIN role is required; a missing cinema returns 404 and existing auditoriums cause 409.

get.description: Returns non-cancelled showtimes starting on the given Vietnam local calendar date. The date is required; cinemaId and movieId optionally filter the results. This read is public.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Required Vietnam local date, interpreted from 00:00 to 24:00.

post.description: Schedules a movie in an auditorium. End time is fixed at creation as movie duration plus 15 minutes for cleaning; screenings in the same auditorium cannot overlap. Base price is a positive VND amount. Missing movie/auditorium returns 404 and an overlap returns 409. Requires ADMIN.

Cancels a showtime until its endsAt. A reason is required; OTHER requires a nonblank note of at most 200 characters. Confirmed bookings are refunded and Pending bookings removed. An unknown showtime returns 404; a cancelled or ended showtime returns 409. Requires ADMIN.

get.description: Returns a page of movies ordered by title. Defaults to page=0 and size=20 (max 100); totals are returned in X-Total-Count, X-Page, X-Page-Size, and X-Total-Pages headers. This read is public; a supplied invalid bearer token is rejected.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page (1–100).

post.description: Adds a movie to the catalogue. Duration must be positive; age rating is descriptive only. Requires ADMIN.

Changes the authenticated account's password at runtime without restarting the service. Requires the current password; newPassword must contain at least 8 characters. On success, revokes all refresh tokens for the account and blacklists the current access token. When called by an ADMIN, records an ADMIN_PASSWORD_CHANGED audit entry in the same transaction.

get.description: Returns a page of cinemas ordered by name. Defaults to page=0 and size=20 (max 100); totals are returned in X-Total-Count, X-Page, X-Page-Size, and X-Total-Pages headers. This catalogue read is public; a supplied invalid bearer token is rejected.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page (1–100).

post.description: Creates a cinema. The name and address must be nonblank; an authenticated ADMIN role is required.

get.description: Returns auditorium summaries for an existing cinema; seat details are omitted. Missing cinema returns 404. This catalogue read is public.

post.description: Creates an auditorium under an existing cinema. Its name must be unique within that cinema. Rows are A–Z (1–26); each row has a positive seat count. VIP and couple rows must refer to distinct valid row letters. Missing cinema returns 404 and a duplicate name returns 409. Requires ADMIN.

get.description: Returns a page of the authenticated customer's bookings, newest first. Defaults to page=0 and size=20 (max 100); totals are returned in X-Total-Count, X-Page, X-Page-Size, and X-Total-Pages headers. Requires CUSTOMER.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page (1–100).

post.description: Creates a 10-minute Pending hold for 1–8 unique seats in a future, non-cancelled showtime. Customers can have at most one live Pending booking; taken seats, cancelled/started showtimes, or an existing hold cause 409. Duplicate IDs or seats outside its auditorium are 400; an unknown showtime is 404. Requires CUSTOMER.

Simulates payment for a live Pending booking. Supports an optional Idempotency-Key header so retried or concurrent requests return the same result without creating a duplicate transaction; reusing a key on a different booking returns 409. An expired hold returns 409; retrying payment for an already Confirmed booking returns it unchanged. Missing or another customer's booking returns 404. Requires CUSTOMER.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Booking UUID owned by the authenticated customer.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated idempotency key (1–128 characters) to safely retry payment.

post.description: Public self-registration creates a CUSTOMER account. Email addresses are normalized; an existing email returns 409. The password must contain at least 8 characters.

errors.message: Password must be at least 8 characters

post.description: Public endpoint that exchanges an active refresh token for a new short-lived Bearer access token and a rotated refresh token. Presenting an unknown, expired, or revoked refresh token returns 401; replaying an already-used refresh token also revokes its entire token family.

Revokes the caller's current Bearer access token by adding it to the token blacklist so further requests using that token fail with 401, and revokes the refresh token family linked to the access token. If an additional refreshToken belonging to the caller is supplied in the optional request body, its refresh token family is also revoked.

Public login authenticates with email and password and returns a short-lived Bearer access token (default 15 minutes) and a revocable rotating refresh token. Unknown email and wrong password share the same 401 response; login applies only nonblank validation.

get.description: Returns a page of database-managed ADMIN accounts ordered by email. Defaults to page=0 and size=20 (max 100); totals are returned in X-Total-Count, X-Page, X-Page-Size, and X-Total-Pages headers. Requires ADMIN.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page (1-100).

post.description: Creates a new database-managed ADMIN account and records an ADMIN_CREATED audit log entry in the same transaction. Email addresses are normalized; an existing email returns 409. Requires ADMIN.

get.description: Returns a showtime by UUID, including its cancellation status and reason when cancelled. An unknown showtime returns 404. This read is public.

delete.description: Hard-deletes a showtime only when it has no live Pending or Confirmed/Refunded bookings; lapsed holds are removed with it. Unknown showtime returns 404, dependent booking 409. Requires ADMIN.

get.description: Returns every seat with its current availability and calculated VND price. An unknown showtime returns 404; a cancelled showtime returns 409. This read is public.
Returns the account identified by the JWT subject. Any authenticated role may call this operation; if the account no longer exists the response is 404.
Returns a booking owned by the authenticated customer. Another customer's booking is indistinguishable from a missing booking and returns 404. Requires CUSTOMER.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Booking UUID owned by the authenticated customer.

delete.description: Deletes a Pending booking and releases its seats. Expired holds can be abandoned too. Confirmed or Refunded bookings cannot be cancelled by a customer and return 409. Missing or another customer's booking returns 404. Requires CUSTOMER.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Booking UUID owned by the authenticated customer.

get.description: Returns an auditorium and its generated seats. This catalogue read is public; an unknown auditorium returns 404.

delete.description: Hard-deletes an auditorium only when it has no showtimes. Requires ADMIN; an unknown auditorium returns 404 and dependent showtimes cause 409.

get.description: Returns a page of append-only administrative audit entries ordered newest first. Optionally filters by action, targetType, targetId, and actorId. Totals are returned in X-Total-Count, X-Page, X-Page-Size, and X-Total-Pages headers. Requires ADMIN.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page (1-100).

description.description: Nonblank movie synopsis; no API length limit is defined.

releaseDate.description: Release date as an ISO-8601 calendar date.

posterUrl.description: Nonblank poster URL; no API length limit is defined.

address.description: Nonblank street address; no API length limit is defined.

startsAt.description: Start instant as ISO-8601 date-time with an offset.

basePrice.description: Positive integer VND base price, at most 100,000,000.

endsAt.description: Fixed end instant (movie duration plus 15 minutes).

reason.description: Cancellation reason. OTHER requires a nonblank note.

note.description: Optional note (0–200 characters); required when reason is OTHER.

newPassword.description: New password with a minimum length of 8 characters.

name.description: Nonblank name unique within its cinema.

rows.description: Lettered rows A–Z; choose 1 to 26 rows.

seatsPerRow.description: Positive number of seats in each row.

seats.description: Generated seats; omitted in auditorium summaries.

number.description: One-based seat position in the row.

seatIds.description: Choose 1–8 unique seat IDs for this showtime.

price.description: Seat price copied when the booking was created, in integer VND.

status.description: Booking state, including computed EXPIRED for elapsed holds.

expiresAt.description: Hold expiry instant (10 minutes after creation).

seats.description: Seats and their prices copied when booked.

email.description: Nonblank email address used to identify the account.

password.description: Password with a minimum length of 8 characters.

refreshToken.description: Active refresh token returned by login or a previous refresh.
Optional refresh token to revoke alongside the current access token.

email.description: Nonblank email address for the new admin account.

seatIds.description: Seat IDs that were already held or sold; only present for seat-taken conflicts.
